name: Enterprise Product, Offering and Roadmap
constraints: WM-ECO-021 owns only recipient-specific proposal prices and named terms and references Offering identity plus a contained Price Plan composite path; it never owns list price or catalogue identity.

A subscription agreement always pins Offering identity plus its contained Price Plan path; an accepted quote is only an additional price/term overlay and cannot introduce entitlement, packaging or eligibility.
Roadmap Item profiles WM-ACT-008 as non-contractual planning intent with schedule, confidence, version and realization links.
Roadmap Item owns no orderability, price, eligibility, SLA, entitlement, subscription binding or contractual commitment basis.
Roadmap to catalogue reference is one-way, optional and non-binding; it may be unresolved and never blocks catalogue publication.
Roadmap Item never proves availability, release, entitlement, task completion, delivery or contractual obligation.
Availability requires an authoritative Offering or release record and delivery requires an act record.
Product survives tariff, market withdrawal and roadmap-confidence changes.
Price Plan is a non-addressable Offering component reached only through Offering identity, planName and planVersionOrdinal.
Any upstream revision of either pinned base invalidates this audit and requires a new reconciliation.
holds: Both source bases remain non-canonical at the pinned revisions.
Registry allocations and relation contracts remain pending.
Fixtures are specified but not executed.
